Great ambience, staff, food and drinks! What's not to love
Jan 2024 • Couples
We stayed in Tam Coc and visited twice.... First for lunch which was fab and secondly for dinner on our last night. Craft beer selection was great. Vegetarian options are plentiful. Staff are so friendly and helpful. Setting and ambience just perfect. Sadly Tam Coc rained for the entirety of our stay BUT that did not detract from our stay, the village and scenery is breathtaking and made even more pleasant visiting this restaurant. Our last dinner consisted of 2 craft beers (one bottle one draught.... Jasmaine) one bottle of Hanoi beer and a margarita cocktail, stire fried shrimp with sticky rice and stir fried tofu woth noodles total 555,000 VD) The demographic was great, a mix of all ages, nationalities..... just a really relaxed atmosphere. I would highly recommend.
